https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49942/Techno_Banter_Ultimate_Mix/

notes.title: Patch #1 just made its way into Rainbow Drive!
notes.content:
Dropping the promised patch, just in time for the weekend!

If you were waiting a little while for us to implement a few fixes before buying, but still wanted to take advantage of the -20% Launch Discount, this is the perfect moment!

As previously mentioned, and without further ado, here are the patchnotes!

Patch #1:
New Features

Invert Y axis setting, for all fighter jet enthusiasts
Alternative controls for minigames (Arrow keys for Movement, Right Shift for Dash!)
Improvements:

Nill should appear in correct clothes (or without them) in all places in the game
Restored animations on Nill Status Wheel (for some reason, our beary kind friend doesn't react at all!)
Visual and functional rework of Skills Menu, to adjust it to how the conversation Skill Wheel works
Visual improvements here and there!

As always, please feel free to reach out to us either directly on our Discord or the Steam Discussions.

If you like Techno Banter, we'd really appreciate you leaving a review!

notes.title: Unveiling the Roadmap!
notes.content:
Releasing the game is never the end of the story! 

We've already released one Hotfix to address the first issues that came in over the launch weekend.

Gathering all the feedback we've received from our lovely players, we've decided to Map out the Road (get it?) we'll be taking to polish and upgrade the game, taking into consideration both simple bugfixes, as well as additional changes to improve the quality of life.

Steam is our first priority, but these changes will soon make their way onto other platforms as well!

Patch #1: (Coming February 7th)
New Features

Invert Y axis setting, for all fighter jet enthusiasts
Alternative controls for minigames (Arrow keys for Movement, Right Shift for Dash!)
Improvements:

Nill should appear in correct clothes (or without them) in all places in the game
Restored animations on Nill Status Wheel (for some reason, our beary kind friend doesn't react at all!)
Visual and functional rework of Skills Menu, to adjust it to how the conversation Skill Wheel works
Visual improvements here and there!


Patch #2:(Coming February 24th)
New Features

 Better balancing of minigames (l00king at you, Stare-down)
Robust integration with Logitech LIGHTSYNC, that will light up your hardware like no other game ever did! We're embracing the colorful vibe of the game with this one for sure.
Improvements:

Visual improvements in UI and better text visibility
UX upgrades in controller usage and how clearly game communicates "things"
Quest system improvements, with better feedback in certain quests
Mmaybe we will even move the Seaside sign lower!

That's it for now, but please do let us know what you think either directly on our Discord or the Steam Discussions.

If you do like Techno Banter, we'd really appreciate you leaving a review!

notes.title: The Hotfix is here!
notes.content:
Seeing you all explore Rainbow Drive and become absolute rulers of the Green Door queue has warmed our hearts beyond words, and we couldn't be more thankful for all your feedback!

That being said, we wanted to address (and fix) the issues you have been reporting throughout the Launch Weekend, so here it is! 

The first patch for Techno Banter!

This hotfix aims to address all the issues connected to progressing through the game:

 Fixed inability to select certain dialogue options using the controller
 Fixed soft-lock caused by using skills without the required hype level
 Fixed inability to progress through the Red Flags explanation during the dialogue with Gunthy


If you run into any more pesky bugs, feel free to reach out to us either through our Discord server, our Community Hub or directly to our team at support@crunchingkoalas.com

notes.title: Techno Banter demo is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's the Techno Banter team here - we're BACK and super thrilled to show you the demo of our game!


BACK? What was going on for the last few months?
After showcasing the game on multiple in-person events last year, including AMAZE, Gamescom or PAX West; we agreed on a difficult decision to completely replace the UI system. We've been working on it very hard for the last couple of months, and while it's still not fully finished, we think it's ready to be shown in the demo version of the game. We will be very happy to hear your feedback on it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087522/fdbd7062b39b989e37060ee1594a904462b1e8c2.png

What can be found in the demo version?
The game consists of a few days during which the whole plot of the game happens - the demo consists currently of one, nearly full, day to play. You will be able to meet some of the inhabitants of Rainbow Drive (the main location of the game), go to the Green Door club, where you will work the queue as the bouncer; receive quests that will be playable in the full version of the game; and get to meet your co-workers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087522/08dbd186f2450d5cc7601a23961d46e268f20d34.png

What's next for us and the game?
The game is currently close to being finished (contentwise), and we're planning to work on it, polish it, release updates of the demo during some of the incoming Steam events, showcase the game on one or two bigger showcases, and release the full version of the game around September/October!

So please follow us, wishlist the game, and stay with us for the remainder of the development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348400/Techno_Banter/

Cheers,
Techno Banter team - Dexai Arts and Crunching Koalas

notes.title: The first previews for Techno Banter just dropped!
notes.content:
Hello to all the potential future bouncers and gritty techno enjoyers! We're here to tell you what we've been up to lately, as well as a bit about how you can get your hands on the project earlier than everyone else!

Back in May we featured our game at A MAZE!
Besides hosting a super fun party, we've showcased our game to the press! Last night all the preview articles dropped for everyone to see!

[previewyoutube=I03lxSPIPMo;full][/previewyoutube]

"Techno Banter is going to be something special."
                    - God is a Geek

If there's one thing we can say about the coverage is we're very pleased with the reception!

"Techno Banter is unusual but addictive."
                    -Movies Games and Tech

We're really excited to share this game with everyone, so you can expect to try it out at various different game conferences! The one we're certainly going to be on is Gamescom this August! Expect a sweet demo, lots of pins, masks, knickknacks and what-nots to be up for grabs, too!

"There’s a really interesting blend of ideas in Techno Banter that I’m looking forward to exploring further."
                   -The Sixth Axis

We'll see you soon!
